Backend: 17/17 pytest tests green in /app/backend/tests/test_phase3.py against the REAL migrated coach jcgfit@gmail.com (61 programs, 13 clients, 52 check-ins). Coverage: (1) POST /coach/inbox/{log_id}/reply — inserts message coach->client (verified via GET /chat/{peer}/messages), marks reviewed=True and stores coach_reply on the log; 422 on empty text; 404 on unknown log; 403 for client role. (2) GET /coach/exercise-library — returns 200+ distinct exercises aggregated from coaching_sessions with usage_count sorted desc, source='program'; POST creates 'manual' entry (id lib_...) and DELETE removes it; 403 for client; 422 on empty name. (3) GET /coach/clients/{id} now returns streak (int>=0), total_checkins, week_checkins, last_active ISO string (or null); 404 for unrelated client. (5) GET /me/dashboard-layout returns default 5 sections all visible in order [stats, quick_actions, needs_attention, inbox_preview, recent_activity]; PUT persists reorder+hide, unknown keys are dropped, missing canonical keys appended; 401 without auth. Reset to defaults confirmed persistence works both directions. (C) Inbox tab renders 52 items; tapping reply-<log_id> expands composer with reply-input-<log_id> and send-reply-<log_id>; sending 'TEST_p3_UI reply ...' shows 'You replied: ...' green preview + card flips to Reviewed. (D) /exercise-library screen: search filters by name (typed 'squat' matched), add-exercise-btn opens modal (exercise-name-input, exercise-note-input, save-exercise-btn), added entry appears with SAVED chip, delete-exercise-<id> removes it. (F) On coach-owned program /program/strength_mobility_block_1, header duplicate-program-btn creates a copy and navigates to /program/prog_e2e0f3e0e096 titled '4-Week Strength & Mobility - Block 1 (Copy)' with all 7-day schedule copied — test cleaned up the duplicate afterward.
action_items: No blocking issues found. All 5 new features (inbox reply, exercise library, client progress, program duplicate, customize dashboard) are working correctly at both API and UI layers.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_coach.py::reply_checkin correctly guards with require_coach + coach_id match (403 for non-owner). Message payload is minted with uuid msg_ prefix and coach_reply is stored alongside reviewed=True in the log — atomic in one $set. Good.

routes_coach.py::exercise_library merges auto-aggregated sessions with manual entries by lowercase-name key; usage_count is preserved when a manual entry overrides an auto one — sensible. Sort by (-usage_count, name) is stable.

routes_coach.py::_checkin_stats naive streak computation walks backwards from today (or yesterday if no log today) — matches dashboard streak logic in routes_misc.py. Both use _aware helper consistently. No timezone divergence risk.

routes_programs.py::duplicate_program correctly re-owns each referenced session (owner_id=coach) with a fresh ses_ id and new schedule mapping — no reference leakage. is_template hardcoded False on the copy (prevents accidental template propagation). Name suffix trims to 100 chars.

routes_misc.py::dashboard-layout PUT sanitizes unknown keys, dedupes, and appends any missing canonical sections with visible=True — schema-safe. The saved doc is a plain list of {key,visible} — no _id leakage.

Frontend CoachHome.tsx pulls layout in parallel with stats/clients/activity/inbox in one Promise.all — good. Uses layout.sections?.length ? layout.sections : DEFAULT_LAYOUT as safe fallback. renderSection switch matches all 5 keys.

dashboard-customize.tsx uses simple up/down arrow reorder without library — clean. Switch component uses correct trackColor. save-layout-btn calls PUT then router.back() so returning to Home re-runs load() via useFocusEffect and reflects new layout.
exercise-library.tsx uses Modal + KeyboardAvoidingView for the add sheet; testIDs correct. On delete, does optimistic removal with fallback re-load on error — resilient.

program/[id].tsx: duplicate handler uses router.replace so back button doesn't send you back to the source program (better UX). Owner check (isOwner) hides duplicate/edit/delete icons for clients — correct.

inbox.tsx composer is inline per-card (not modal) so multiple rows keep independent state via replyingId — good. Optimistic UI updates coach_reply and reviewed locally after send. No _id leakage in payloads.
